rawBlockNode.name: secC1T
rawBlockNode.content: Our technology delivers mobility, adaptive intelligence and resilient communications for security missions. Always-on solutions can be rapidly deployed or withdrawn, ensuring uptime demands of covert and sensitive missions.

rawBlockNode.name: secC2T
rawBlockNode.content: Our security-grade mobile satellite network provides in-demand connections to remote and challenging border environments while maintaining command continuity and response capabilities with full mission videos and data transmission.

rawBlockNode.name: emC1T
rawBlockNode.content: Kymeta technology provides emergency responders with flexible, resilient communications in crisis situations. Our network offerings, terminal and services solutions offer an adaptable, easy-to-deploy communications environment when in extreme need. This robust communication infrastructure supports first responders, enhancing their ability to coordinate lifesaving efforts and improve emergency response effectiveness.

rawBlockNode.name: emC2T
rawBlockNode.content: In times of fire and crisis, Kymeta is ready to deploy terminals offer firefighters and command centers with minimal power requirements. Our technology provides exceptional high-volume data transfer and low-latency sharing and voice communication to enhance situational awareness and firefighting capabilities, even in the most demanding environments.

rawBlockNode.name: secDesc
rawBlockNode.content: Kymeta provides robust hybrid connectivity and real-time command insight for defense missions, border security and intelligence operations. Our adaptive solutions ensure critical data and communication remain secure and accessible in dynamic situations.

rawBlockNode.name: emDesc
rawBlockNode.content: Kymeta empowers emergency responders with resilient access to easy-to-deploy solutions during crises. Our rapidly adaptive network and communications solutions enable front-line teams and command center operations with continuous situational awareness and response effectiveness.

children.name: r2d
children.content: Able to switch dynamically between LEO, GEO and cellular networks, this turnkey terminal easily integrates with existing systems. Robust and durable hardware suitable for security and intelligence agencies.

rawBlockNode.name: sec1desc
rawBlockNode.content: In an increasingly complex world, assured connectivity is not merely a convenience — it’s a vital requirement for mission success. Our intelligent communications platforms provide resilient, always-on connectivity and situational awareness, ensuring that military personnel and emergency responders can execute their critical missions effectively and without compromise.

rawBlockNode.name: sec1desc
rawBlockNode.content: We are driven by a singular mission: to empower those who safeguard our nations and communities. Our resilient technologies are designed with usability in mind, including extreme environments, to integrate seamlessly with military vehicles and vessels, providing reliable tactical connectivity on the move, on land and at sea.
